title: NQ Overnight Range at the Cash Open
summary: Measures overnight boundary reaches, timing, range width, and pre-open VXN and VIX associations on NQ, with two eras and a recent yearly breakdown.
data_summary: 2015 through September 18, 2026. The verified sample contains 1,827 eligible inside-range sessions, including 307 from 2015–2019.
evidence_status: Executed six-theme notebook and verified local review report. The earlier era is concentrated in 2018–2019. Touches are measured on one-minute OHLC and the analysis does not estimate returns.
